risks.name: Compromise of privileged identity
risks.statement: A privileged identity is compromised or used without strong authentication, just-in-time access, review, or local administrator controls.
risks.impact: Unauthorized control of Arc-connected resources and administrative paths.

risks.name: Unsafe onboarding identity or secret
risks.statement: Onboarding credentials, service principals, managed identities, or provider registration are overprivileged, exposed, stale, or incorrectly scoped.
risks.impact: Unauthorized enrollment, persistence, or resource creation.

risks.name: Control-plane privilege escalation
risks.statement: RBAC, Policy, Run Command, Admin Center, or cross-subscription control-plane paths enable excessive privilege or unreviewed sensitive operations.
risks.impact: Privilege escalation and remote administrative execution.

risks.name: Network and name-resolution boundary bypass
risks.statement: Public access, inbound ports, DNS, Private Link, or connectivity allowances permit an unintended management path.
risks.impact: Exposure or bypass of the intended network security boundary.

risks.name: Agent, extension, or local-control tampering
risks.statement: Unsupported agents, failed extensions, unsafe agent mode, local accounts, or host policy weaknesses permit tampering or loss of trust.
risks.impact: Compromised host management channel and unreliable evidence.

risks.name: Abuse of extensions and remote execution
risks.statement: Sensitive or unapproved extensions, Run Command, or extension lifecycle operations are abused for code execution.
risks.impact: Remote execution, persistence, and lateral movement.

risks.name: Security telemetry blind spot
risks.statement: Defender, MDE, AMA, DCR, Sentinel, Activity Log, retention, or health coverage is missing or degraded.
risks.impact: Attacks are not detected, investigated, or contained in time.

risks.name: Exploitation of vulnerability or legacy platform
risks.statement: Missing patches, unsupported versions, weak baseline, unhealthy EDR, or absent encryption leaves exploitable conditions.
risks.impact: Host compromise, credential theft, and data exposure.

risks.name: Governance, lifecycle, or scope drift
risks.statement: Inventory, tiering, tags, policy, automation, rollout, review, cost, or decommission controls drift from the approved design.
risks.impact: Unmanaged attack surface and inconsistent control enforcement.

risks.name: SQL protection, entitlement, or telemetry failure
risks.statement: SQL-enabled Arc resources lack protection, least privilege, accurate licensing, or reliable usage upload.
risks.impact: Database exposure, audit gaps, or billing and entitlement risk.

risks.name: Operational resilience and recovery failure
risks.statement: Disconnected assets, rollback, removal, exception, health review, or recovery evidence is absent or ineffective.
risks.impact: Prolonged outage, orphaned access, or inability to restore a trusted state.

securityBoundaries.name: Azure management-plane boundary
securityBoundaries.to: ARM, RBAC, Policy and Arc control plane
